messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: User specied region in Module 4
parts:
Hi Suresh, 
I think you are missing a decimal and meant to set the multiplier step as 0.5, not 5. This is the incremental increase, so if the regularization starts at 0.5, the next value would be 5.5, but you set the upper limit to 3- this is why each feature class only has one model.
If you set the step value to 0.5, you will get 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 ... etc.... for both LQH and LQHP.

Bethany

messages.subject: Re: User specied region in Module 4
parts: The polygon you upload needs to encompass all the occurrence records. If for some reason any of the points are falling on the line(for example, if you uploaded a minimum convex polygon made from your records) then it will count them as falling outside. Try setting a very small buffer and see if that removes the error.
